Choosing a headlamp for night walks

Brightness is the number most people compare first, but beam shape matters more for walking. A wide, soft flood lights the path at your feet, while a narrow spot is better for reading a sign far ahead.

Look for a lamp with a red light mode. Red keeps your eyes adjusted to the dark and does not startle other walkers or wildlife.

Battery life is quoted at the lowest setting, so plan on about a third of the stated hours at full power. A lamp that takes a common rechargeable cell is easier to keep running on a long trip.
